import sys, random, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/submission')
import main

def check_witness(g,res):
    if res['terminates']:
        assert res['liveness'] is None
        return
    w=res['liveness']; pre=w['prefix']; loop=w['loop']
    assert loop
    n=g['n']; done=g['done_nodes']; start=g['start']; out=g['out']
    assert not done[start]
    cur=start
    assert not done[cur]
    for eid in pre:
        assert eid>=0
        matches=[x for x in out[cur] if x[2]==eid]
        assert matches,(cur,eid)
        cur=matches[0][0]
        assert not done[cur]
    root=cur
    # loop starts root and ends root; track all states and edge names
    states=[cur]
    acts=[]
    for eid in loop:
        if eid==-1:
            assert cur==cur
            states.append(cur);acts.append(None);continue
        matches=[x for x in out[cur] if x[2]==eid]
        assert matches,(cur,eid,loop)
        t,a,_=matches[0]
        cur=t;states.append(cur);acts.append(a)
        assert not done[cur]
    assert cur==root,(root,cur,loop)
    # repeating loop: tail state set includes states at beginnings of edges;
    # states list includes root duplicate; same set either way
    ss=set(states)
    # action enabled complete graph
    for bit,(aid,mode) in enumerate(g['fairness']):
        occurrences=any(a==aid for a in acts)
        if occurrences: continue
        en=[any(a==aid for _t,a,_e in out[v]) for v in ss]
        if mode=='weak':
            assert not all(en),('weak',bit,w,ss,en)
        else:
            assert not any(en),('strong',bit,w,ss,en)

def brute(g, max_len=10):
    # enumerate closed non-done walks reachable by non-done prefix; DFS all
    start=g['start']; done=g['done_nodes'];out=g['out'];n=g['n']
    if done[start]:return False
    # reachable non-done
    reach={start}; stack=[start]
    while stack:
        v=stack.pop()
        for t,a,e in out[v]:
            if not done[t] and t not in reach:reach.add(t);stack.append(t)
    # all stutters
    fairness=g['fairness']
    def fair(root, states, acts):
        for aid,mode in fairness:
            if any(a==aid for a in acts):continue
            en=[any(a==aid for _t,a,_e in out[v]) for v in states]
            if mode=='weak':
                if all(en):return False
            else:
                if any(en):return False
        return True
    for v in reach:
        if fair(v,{v},[]):return True
    # DFS closed walks, restricted to reach; all states non-done. Limit enough for tiny tests
    for root in reach:
        def dfs(v,states,acts,depth):
            if depth>0 and v==root and fair(root,states,acts):return True
            if depth==max_len:return False
            for t,a,e in out[v]:
                if t in reach:
                    if dfs(t,states|{t},acts+[a],depth+1):return True
            return False
        if dfs(root,{root},[],0):return True
    return False

random.seed(4)

    # dedup
    edges=list({tuple(x) for x in edges});edges=[list(x) for x in edges]
    fairness=[]

        if random.random()<.4:fairness.append({'action':a,'mode':random.choice(['weak','strong'])})
    obj={'op':'audit','inputs':[[[0]]],'states':states,'edges':edges,'start':random.randrange(n),'fairness':fairness}
    try:g=main.validate_graph(obj)

    res=main.audit(g)
